description: This file defines the 'Marketplace' controller class within the Opencart admin extension, responsible for listing, installing, and uninstalling marketplace extensions through various methods.

classes.name: Marketplace
classes.description: Controller class managing the marketplace extensions, including displaying available extensions, and handling installation and uninstallation.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial method that outputs the extension list by calling getList and setting response output.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares data about available and installed marketplace extensions for display.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process of a marketplace extension, including permission checks, autoload registration, and calling an extension-specific install controller if present.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation of a marketplace extension, including permission checks and invoking an extension-specific uninstall controller.
